principle: An open-source code sample, an article and a verified Solana claim are different evidence categories

projects.name: Why-Solana-Memecoins-Are-Over
projects.adopt: Sample scopes and historical non-profit findings, not direct trading rules
projects.limits: Selected event sample, cross-chapter cohorts differ; estimates must stay within exact sample.

projects.name: CyberLeek on-chain investigations
projects.adopt: Independent RPC replay and signature-indexed claims; actual value/LP vs cashout separation.
projects.limits: Raw RPC dumps not stored in repo, independent local reproduction not run; one campaign does not give prevalence.

projects.name: Degen-Scanner
projects.adopt: Deployer to upstream funding to buyers to shared collectors pipeline; multi-provider event discovery.
projects.limits: README live claims/cluster scores not independently validated; payment labels and operational ownership cannot be inferred.

projects.name: solana-holder-clusters
projects.adopt: Unknown-first-funder-on-full-page, CEX infrastructure bucket, explicit supply coverage and risk score ingredients.
projects.limits: First-funder approximation from earliest fetched transaction can miss complex funding, RPC history and further hops; shared funder != same owner; library tests claimed not run here.

projects.name: solana-scam-tracker
projects.adopt: Repeated fixed amount and hub→creator→bot operational signature as hypothesis generator.
projects.limits: Monitors known hub with hardcoded amount, not broad normal/abnormal detector or proven common beneficial owner.

projects.name: Find The Insiders
projects.adopt: Explainable first-block wallet view and graph navigation, not certainty of control.
projects.limits: 0–100 insider score not independently calibrated, dashboard may support simulation mode; no direct proof of insider identity.

projects.name: Crypto-Clusters
projects.adopt: Candidate graph UI architecture and community visualization.
projects.limits: Louvain clusters are graph communities, not real-world owners. Sparse repository and limited independent validation.

projects.name: HoldTech
projects.adopt: Gini/HHI, holder age distribution as descriptive hypotheses.
projects.limits: README equates same-slot/funded-by-same-source with bundle/manufactured users; requires independent Jito proof, denominator audit, and normal controls.

projects.name: SentinelBag
projects.adopt: Enumerate temporal 2/3-hop token cycles and distinct recipient counts as candidates.
projects.limits: A-B-A transfer loop is not automatically executed wash trade; arbitrary 10/20 thresholds and 100 risk score not calibrated.

projects.name: solana-memecoin-dataset
projects.adopt: Build time-correct cohort/wallet/funder joins and benchmark from available data after field audits.
projects.limits: GMGN just-graduated/trending sampling, ~20 days, survivorship bias, max-forward-return label not executable PnL. GMGN API may be cost restricted.

projects.name: Early-Buyer Groups and Fast-Wallet Teams 2026-10-29
projects.adopt: Prospective co-buy/funding/joint-sign/transfer/consolidation, unseen links and equal-budget controls; exact reserves/self-impact in paper execution model.
projects.limits: Preprint 88.3h single market window; authors' reported results not independently reproduced here; groups not confirmed legal/identity manipulation. Replication package code availability unverified.

projects.name: RED-COHORT 2026 corrected/withdrawn numbers
projects.adopt: Build a source classification validation gate; retract all dependent claims upon sell-as-buy finding.
projects.limits: Earlier 1,012 cohort/PSM buyer-flow numerical findings withdrawn, cannot cite as validated effects; corrected versions also require careful independent validation.

projects.name: Yellowstone gRPC + Chainstack gRPC tutorial
projects.adopt: M1 ingestion contract with source metadata, replay/coverage, transaction position, decode boundary.
projects.limits: Docs/sample clients are not an already connected provider, backfill limitations and cost/latency unknown in Grok.

projects.name: GraphSense
projects.adopt: Graph investigation UX, entity attribution tags with provenance, path query semantics.
projects.limits: Current advertised supported chains not Solana; do not recommend as direct Solana backend or assume integration.
